dataSource.select:
/* Formatted on 12/3/2024 11:39:10 AM (QP5 v5.294) */ --==============================================================================================
SELECT '1' TYP, PORT_CD, IMPR_NBR, HQ_IMPR_NBR, IMPR_TYPE_CD, CTRY_CD, BUS_ID_TYPE_CD, BUS_ID, BUS_ID_BRNCH, BUS_ID_EXPRD_DT, CTRY_CD_OF_ID, CITY_CODE_OF_ID, IMPR_EXPR_TYPE, ARBC_IMPR_NAME, ENG_IMPR_NAME, IMPR_NAME_STD, IMPR_NBR_PARENT, IMPR_CNTCT_NAME, IMPR_TEL_NBR, IMPR_POB_NBR, IMPR_ZIP_CD, IMPR_FAX_NBR, IMPR_TELEX_NBR, EMAIL, ADD_CTRY_CD, CITY_CODE, LST_TRAN_DT, IMPD_STMT_NBR, IMPR_DATA_SRCE, WVR_ENTRY_NBR, EXPD_STMT_NBR, ACTIVITY, CAR_AGENT_FLAG, COMM_RGSTRTN_TYPE, CUSTOMS_ENTERED, BANK_IBAN, MOBILE_NO, EXPRESS_POST, ID_NBR FROM IMPORTERS WHERE IMPR_TYPE_CD IN (1, 5, 8) AND BUS_ID_TYPE_CD = 2 AND port_cd = :P_CURR_PORT_CD AND ( ( COMM_RGSTRTN_TYPE = 1 AND (BUS_ID IS NULL OR BUS_ID_BRNCH IS NOT NULL))) AND ( (:P_TYPE = 1 AND BUS_ID_EXPRD_DT <= :CF_CURR_DT) OR (:P_TYPE = 2 AND BUS_ID_EXPRD_DT > :CF_CURR_DT) OR (:P_TYPE = 3)) UNION ALL SELECT '2' TYP, PORT_CD, IMPR_NBR, HQ_IMPR_NBR, IMPR_TYPE_CD, CTRY_CD, BUS_ID_TYPE_CD, BUS_ID, BUS_ID_BRNCH, BUS_ID_EXPRD_DT, CTRY_CD_OF_ID, CITY_CODE_OF_ID, IMPR_EXPR_TYPE, ARBC_IMPR_NAME, ENG_IMPR_NAME, IMPR_NAME_STD, IMPR_NBR_PARENT, IMPR_CNTCT_NAME, IMPR_TEL_NBR, IMPR_POB_NBR, IMPR_ZIP_CD, IMPR_FAX_NBR, IMPR_TELEX_NBR, EMAIL, ADD_CTRY_CD, CITY_CODE, LST_TRAN_DT, IMPD_STMT_NBR, IMPR_DATA_SRCE, WVR_ENTRY_NBR, EXPD_STMT_NBR, ACTIVITY, CAR_AGENT_FLAG, COMM_RGSTRTN_TYPE, CUSTOMS_ENTERED, BANK_IBAN, MOBILE_NO, EXPRESS_POST, ID_NBR FROM IMPORTERS WHERE IMPR_TYPE_CD IN (1, 5, 8) AND BUS_ID_TYPE_CD = 2 AND port_cd = :P_CURR_PORT_CD AND ( (COMM_RGSTRTN_TYPE = 2 AND BUS_ID_BRNCH IS NULL)) AND ( (:P_TYPE = 1 AND BUS_ID_EXPRD_DT <= :CF_CURR_DT) OR (:P_TYPE = 2 AND BUS_ID_EXPRD_DT > :CF_CURR_DT) OR (:P_TYPE = 3)) UNION ALL SELECT '3' TYP, PORT_CD, IMPR_NBR, HQ_IMPR_NBR, IMPR_TYPE_CD, CTRY_CD, BUS_ID_TYPE_CD, BUS_ID, BUS_ID_BRNCH, BUS_ID_EXPRD_DT, CTRY_CD_OF_ID, CITY_CODE_OF_ID, IMPR_EXPR_TYPE, ARBC_IMPR_NAME, ENG_IMPR_NAME, IMPR_NAME_STD, IMPR_NBR_PARENT, IMPR_CNTCT_NAME, IMPR_TEL_NBR, IMPR_POB_NBR, IMPR_ZIP_CD, IMPR_FAX_NBR, IMPR_TELEX_NBR, EMAIL, ADD_CTRY_CD, CITY_CODE, LST_TRAN_DT, IMPD_STMT_NBR, IMPR_DATA_SRCE, WVR_ENTRY_NBR, EXPD_STMT_NBR, ACTIVITY, CAR_AGENT_FLAG, COMM_RGSTRTN_TYPE, CUSTOMS_ENTERED, BANK_IBAN, MOBILE_NO, EXPRESS_POST, ID_NBR FROM IMPORTERS WHERE IMPR_TYPE_CD IN (1, 5, 8) AND BUS_ID_TYPE_CD = 2 AND port_cd = :P_CURR_PORT_CD AND ( (COMM_RGSTRTN_TYPE = 1 AND LENGTH (LTRIM (RTRIM (BUS_ID))) <> 10)) AND ( (:P_TYPE = 1 AND BUS_ID_EXPRD_DT <= :CF_CURR_DT) OR (:P_TYPE = 2 AND BUS_ID_EXPRD_DT > :CF_CURR_DT) OR (:P_TYPE = 3)) UNION ALL SELECT '4' TYP, PORT_CD, IMPR_NBR, HQ_IMPR_NBR, IMPR_TYPE_CD, CTRY_CD, BUS_ID_TYPE_CD, BUS_ID, BUS_ID_BRNCH, BUS_ID_EXPRD_DT, CTRY_CD_OF_ID, CITY_CODE_OF_ID, IMPR_EXPR_TYPE, ARBC_IMPR_NAME, ENG_IMPR_NAME, IMPR_NAME_STD, IMPR_NBR_PARENT, IMPR_CNTCT_NAME, IMPR_TEL_NBR, IMPR_POB_NBR, IMPR_ZIP_CD, IMPR_FAX_NBR, IMPR_TELEX_NBR, EMAIL, ADD_CTRY_CD, CITY_CODE, LST_TRAN_DT, IMPD_STMT_NBR, IMPR_DATA_SRCE, WVR_ENTRY_NBR, EXPD_STMT_NBR, ACTIVITY, CAR_AGENT_FLAG, COMM_RGSTRTN_TYPE, CUSTOMS_ENTERED, BANK_IBAN, MOBILE_NO, EXPRESS_POST, ID_NBR FROM IMPORTERS WHERE IMPR_TYPE_CD IN (1, 5, 8) AND BUS_ID_TYPE_CD = 2 AND port_cd = :P_CURR_PORT_CD AND COMM_RGSTRTN_TYPE = 2 AND LENGTH (LTRIM (RTRIM (BUS_ID))) <> 10 AND ( (:P_TYPE = 1 AND BUS_ID_EXPRD_DT <= :CF_CURR_DT) OR (:P_TYPE = 2 AND BUS_ID_EXPRD_DT > :CF_CURR_DT) OR (:P_TYPE = 3)) UNION ALL SELECT '5' TYP, PORT_CD, IMPR_NBR, HQ_IMPR_NBR, IMPR_TYPE_CD, CTRY_CD, BUS_ID_TYPE_CD, BUS_ID, BUS_ID_BRNCH, BUS_ID_EXPRD_DT, CTRY_CD_OF_ID, CITY_CODE_OF_ID, IMPR_EXPR_TYPE, ARBC_IMPR_NAME, ENG_IMPR_NAME, IMPR_NAME_STD, IMPR_NBR_PARENT, IMPR_CNTCT_NAME, IMPR_TEL_NBR, IMPR_POB_NBR, IMPR_ZIP_CD, IMPR_FAX_NBR, IMPR_TELEX_NBR, EMAIL, ADD_CTRY_CD, CITY_CODE, LST_TRAN_DT, IMPD_STMT_NBR, IMPR_DATA_SRCE, WVR_ENTRY_NBR, EXPD_STMT_NBR, ACTIVITY, CAR_AGENT_FLAG, COMM_RGSTRTN_TYPE, CUSTOMS_ENTERED, BANK_IBAN, MOBILE_NO, EXPRESS_POST, ID_NBR FROM IMPORTERS WHERE IMPR_TYPE_CD IN (1, 5, 8) AND BUS_ID_TYPE_CD = 2 AND port_cd = :P_CURR_PORT_CD AND ( (COMM_RGSTRTN_TYPE = 2 AND BUS_ID = BUS_ID_BRNCH)) AND ( (:P_TYPE = 1 AND BUS_ID_EXPRD_DT <= :CF_CURR_DT) OR (:P_TYPE = 2 AND BUS_ID_EXPRD_DT > :CF_CURR_DT) OR (:P_TYPE = 3)) UNION ALL SELECT '6' TYP, PORT_CD, IMPR_NBR, HQ_IMPR_NBR, IMPR_TYPE_CD, CTRY_CD, BUS_ID_TYPE_CD, BUS_ID, BUS_ID_BRNCH, BUS_ID_EXPRD_DT, CTRY_CD_OF_ID, CITY_CODE_OF_ID, IMPR_EXPR_TYPE, ARBC_IMPR_NAME, ENG_IMPR_NAME, IMPR_NAME_STD, IMPR_NBR_PARENT, IMPR_CNTCT_NAME, IMPR_TEL_NBR, IMPR_POB_NBR, IMPR_ZIP_CD, IMPR_FAX_NBR, IMPR_TELEX_NBR, EMAIL, ADD_CTRY_CD, CITY_CODE, LST_TRAN_DT, IMPD_STMT_NBR, IMPR_DATA_SRCE, WVR_ENTRY_NBR, EXPD_STMT_NBR, ACTIVITY, CAR_AGENT_FLAG, COMM_RGSTRTN_TYPE, CUSTOMS_ENTERED, BANK_IBAN, MOBILE_NO, EXPRESS_POST, ID_NBR FROM IMPORTERS WHERE IMPR_TYPE_CD IN (1, 5, 8) AND BUS_ID_TYPE_CD = 2 AND port_cd = :P_CURR_PORT_CD AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT '1' FROM CITIES WHERE CITIES.CTRY_CD = IMPORTERS.CTRY_CD_OF_ID AND CITIES.CITY_CD = IMPORTERS.CITY_CODE_OF_ID AND SUBSTR (CITIES.MINS_COMM_CD, 1) = SUBSTR (BUS_ID, 1, 4)) AND ( (:P_TYPE = 1 AND BUS_ID_EXPRD_DT <= :CF_CURR_DT) OR (:P_TYPE = 2 AND BUS_ID_EXPRD_DT > :CF_CURR_DT) OR (:P_TYPE = 3)) UNION ALL SELECT '7' TYP, PORT_CD, IMPR_NBR, HQ_IMPR_NBR, IMPR_TYPE_CD, CTRY_CD, BUS_ID_TYPE_CD, BUS_ID, BUS_ID_BRNCH, BUS_ID_EXPRD_DT, CTRY_CD_OF_ID, CITY_CODE_OF_ID, IMPR_EXPR_TYPE, ARBC_IMPR_NAME, ENG_IMPR_NAME, IMPR_NAME_STD, IMPR_NBR_PARENT, IMPR_CNTCT_NAME, IMPR_TEL_NBR, IMPR_POB_NBR, IMPR_ZIP_CD, IMPR_FAX_NBR, IMPR_TELEX_NBR, EMAIL, ADD_CTRY_CD, CITY_CODE, LST_TRAN_DT, IMPD_STMT_NBR, IMPR_DATA_SRCE, WVR_ENTRY_NBR, EXPD_STMT_NBR, ACTIVITY, CAR_AGENT_FLAG, COMM_RGSTRTN_TYPE, CUSTOMS_ENTERED, BANK_IBAN, MOBILE_NO, EXPRESS_POST, ID_NBR FROM IMPORTERS WHERE IMPR_TYPE_CD IN (1, 5, 8) AND BUS_ID_TYPE_CD = 2 AND port_cd = :P_CURR_PORT_CD AND (TO_CHAR (BUS_ID)) IN (SELECT TO_CHAR (BUS_ID_BRNCH) FROM COMM_IMPR_RGSTR) AND COMM_RGSTRTN_TYPE = 1 AND ( (:P_TYPE = 1 AND BUS_ID_EXPRD_DT > :CF_CURR_DT) OR (:P_TYPE = 2 AND BUS_ID_EXPRD_DT <= :CF_CURR_DT) OR (:P_TYPE = 3)) --==============================================================================================
